name: STIHL MS 172 C-E
blurb: 31.8 cc. STIHL lists a 16″ bar and 3/8″ PICCO PMM3 chain. PMM3 in this catalog is .043″. The drive-link count is not in the chart.
intro: The STIHL MS 172 C-E is a 31.8 cc gas saw. STIHL's specification table (catalog p. 64, specifications as of 1 October 2024) lists a 16″ bar and 3/8″ PICCO PMM3 chain. The saw-chain chart lists PMM3 at .043″ only (code 3610). STIHL's drive-link chart (catalog pp. 166–167) does not name this model, so this page does not print a drive-link count. Count the drive links on the bar stamp before you order. STIHL's file table lists a 5/32″ (4.0 mm) file for 3/8″ PICCO.
notice: No drive-link count is published for the MS 172 C-E in this catalog. Use the bar stamp.

bars.note: Specification table (catalog p. 64, as of 1 October 2024): 16″ bar, 3/8″ PICCO, chain type PMM3. The chain-type chart lists PMM3 at .043″ (code 3610). No drive-link count is printed for the MS 172 C-E. STIHL's file table lists 5/32″ for 3/8″ PICCO.

sources.title: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog: specification tables (catalog pp. 64–67, specifications as of 1 October 2024) and the guide-bar drive-link chart (catalog pp. 166–167), including the file table and the PMM3/PM3 chain-type rows
